idea-plugin.name: UMLDoclet UML
idea-plugin.description:
Generates PlantUML class and package diagrams from Java sources with UMLDoclet, straight from the Project view or the editor.

What: right-click a Java file, package or source folder and pick Generate UML (UMLDoclet). The plugin runs your project SDK's own javadoc with the bundled UMLDoclet 2.3.2, keeps only the generated .puml files (package layout preserved) in build/uml/, and opens the most relevant diagram.

Why: UMLDoclet emits field associations (Person --> Job, Person --> "*" Hobby), not just inheritance, so the diagram shows how classes actually relate.

How it renders: this plugin has no renderer of its own. Install PlantUML Integration (plantuml4idea) to preview the .puml files; you'll get a hint if it is missing.

Settings (Tools > UMLDoclet): output folder, include private members, and an option to draw field associations as composition (*-->). Caveat: Java cannot express ownership, so that option is a blanket rewrite of every field association, not an analysis.

Needs a full JDK 9+ (with bin/javadoc) as the module SDK.

action.description: Generate PlantUML class diagrams for the selected Java files or packages with UMLDoclet
